text:
有人把企业真实的 AI 模型消费数据拉出来看了一遍，结果和我们每天看到的 Benchmark 热度几乎是两个世界。

Tomasz Tunguz 的分析里，Anthropic 最强的 Fable 5.1 上线前 12 天，只占网关支出的 3.7%。大型企业账户中，前沿模型的 Token 占比也从 8 月的 53% 降到了 9 月的 45%。

更夸张的是 Cursor，基于 Kimi K2.5 微调 Composer 2，整体成本直接降了 86%。

我觉得这里真正值得看的，是企业开始按「每美元能买到多少智能」来选模型。

一个工作流要跑几十、几百次调用，模型只要跨过「够用」那条线，多出来的能力未必值得继续付溢价。接下来模型路由、微调和开放权重都会越来越重要。

Benchmark 在比能力上限，企业真正算的是每个工作流节点的性价比。

AI 模型市场最后最肥的那一块，可能恰恰是中间。

文章：https://t.co/FNYjMRb09z

text:
We comprehensively evaluated 16 recent frontier VLMs - including Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna - on whether higher effort led to better document parsing performance.

Higher effort typically leads to improvements on other benchmarks (coding, knowledge work), but up until recently it wasn't obvious that this natively improved capabilities for reading PDFs.

Results:
✅ Out of the frontier models, Opus 5.5 has the best performance relative to its price. It's especially good at parsing tables.
✅ Astra is also quite good, but starts at a more expensive price than Opus.
✅ GPT-6 Luna is more compelling at the cheaper end of doc parsing

If you're parsing documents at scale, you'll still want a dedicated OCR solution like LlamaParse (https://t.co/XYZmx5TFz8) that has better performance at a cheaper price.

But if you're parsing docs "in the agent loop" within an app like Codex/Claude code, and you're too lazy to integrate a dedicated solution, then Opus 5.5 is currently the leader. 
Full results on ParseBench: https://t.co/PWczfhp0OX

text: One of the most exciting parts of the Quail project (beyond the importance of the application) is how we are building it with agents. (1) We definitely do not want our agents to write all the code from scratch; we want to build on the battle-tested work of the community. (2) It is really important to credit the folks who build foundational infrastructure and algorithms; otherwise, there will be no incentive for people to continue doing foundational research. We see you and are really excited to build on top of what you do!
